'''Peter Doyle''' [[Officer of the Order of the British Empire|OBE]] (20 December 1921 – 31 December 2004) was a British [[chemist]].

==Career==
Doyle obtained his degree from the University of London in 1944.<ref name="HoMBRG">{{cite Q|Q29581637}}</ref> In 1952 he obtained a position at Beecham Laboratories in [[Betchworth]], and became Director of Research at [[Beecham (pharmaceutical company)|Beecham Pharmaceuticals]] in 1962.<ref name="RSC" />

Along with [[Ralph Batchelor]], George Rolinson, and John Nayler, he was part of the team at [[Betchworth]] that discovered and synthesised new [[penicillins]].<ref name="RSC">{{cite web|title=National Chemical Landmark unveiled, celebrating a family of new penicillins|url=http://www.rsc.org/news-events/articles/2016/jun/blue-plaque-for-beechams-at-brockham/|publisher=[[Royal Society of Chemistry]]|accessdate=7 June 2017|language=en|date=15 June 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book| publisher = John Wiley & Sons| isbn = 978-0-471-89979-2| last = Sneader| first = Walter| title = Drug Discovery: A History| year= 2005 |chapter=23: Antibiotic Analogues}}</ref> A [[List of Royal Society of Chemistry blue plaques|Royal Society of Chemistry blue plaque]] now marks this discovery.<ref name="RSC" /> Doyle retired in 1983.<ref name="RSC" />

==Awards==
Doyle was given the [[Worshipful Society of Apothecaries]]' Gold Medal in Therapeutics in 1964 (awarded jointly with Dr. G N Rolinson).<ref name="RSC" />

In 1971, he was among a group awarded the [[Royal Society]]'s [[Mullard Award|Mullard Medal]].<ref name="RSC" />

He was made an [[Officer of the Order of the British Empire]] (OBE) in the [[1977 New Year Honours]] "for services to the pharmaceutical industry".<ref name="RSC" /><ref>{{London Gazette |issue=47102 |date=30 December 1976 |pages=1–34   |supp=y}}</ref>

==Private life==
Frank Peter Doyle and Joan Edith English married in [[Ilford]] in 1946 and had three children: Colin Peter (1949), Robert Allan (1951) and Hilary Joan (1960).

Joan Edith Doyle died on 14 June 2005.
